purpose: Record the output and JSON adapter dry-run before any help, doctor, or shared command package split.
policy: Help and doctor may only proceed to physical split preflight after output mode, stdout/stderr, JSON envelope, support bundle, and CLI JSON contracts are pinned by executable tests.
adapterContracts: withCommandIO restores output mode and stdout/stderr writers
quiet mode suppresses stdout helpers without suppressing stderr errors
verbose mode writes diagnostic output to stderr
printJSONEnvelope keeps ok command version and data fields
printJSONError keeps error code retryable remediation and nextActions fields
WriteErrorJSON keeps the legacy error envelope
doctor --json stays stdout-only with stable nextActions
bug --json supportBundle stays stdout-only with redaction guidance

physicalSplitAdmission.nextAllowedAction: Run a dedicated help and doctor physical split preflight before moving files or changing package boundaries.
physicalSplitAdmission.rollbackRequirement: Restore the current shared IO and JSON helper behavior if output mode, stdout, stderr, JSON fields, support bundle redaction, or CLI JSON contract gates regress.
